title: Where capture-era GLRT finds the missing timing starts

title: Portable differential FFTW scout on ARMv7
boundary: Fixed 20 ms CI16 and three-residue template bank through all coarse timing scores and the top-16 ordering
sample: Three authentic dual-receiver visits and eight signed, one-frame, noise or zero controls
notes: All 293,326 score cells and 22 ordered receiver lists matched x86. Warm scoring used 62.79 ms CPU in Cortex-A9 QEMU and 2.44 ms on native x86. Timing ends before GLRT and represents emulation only.

title: Differential scout runtime parity
boundary: Dual-RX CI16 to the hinted wide fractional detector on one host CPU
sample: 24 primary and 8 confirmation saved visits plus 14 synthetic windows
notes: FFTW reproduced every native payload in this cohort. Complete saved-IQ replay uses the frozen Python scout.

title: Modulo CFO screening on a new differential hint
boundary: Exact raw timing → folded phase candidate mask → native wide fractional GLRT
sample: 16 independent saved dual-RX visits and 14 signed, weak and null controls
notes: Phase skipped 2.6% of the coarse tap work. No end-to-end CPU or recall gain.

title: One-pass dual-receiver preparation in the wide detector
boundary: Saved dual-RX CI16 through full wide detector candidates and gates
sample: 32 scheduled real IQ visits · 30 processed · 270 matched timing pairs
notes: All 480 authentic candidates were identical. The 540 timing rows include both detector calls per pair. The separate low-level profile measured an 11.54% median paired preparation CPU saving.

title: Detector CPU for sparse capture-era routing
boundary: Archived dual-receiver IQ detector clocks → modeled mean CPU per admitted visit
sample: 24,808 stock wide visits across four recordings, with 22 routed per policy and 57 original-detector timing calls
notes: The model stayed below 20 ms mean CPU across the observed capture costs on two recordings. The fastest measured capture-era call took 548 ms wall time. The separate position charts measure full stored-factor replays.

notes: Frequency errors use the capture-era carrier. Position was unmeasured.

title: Held rate evidence for trackless localization

sample: 6 offered queries across 4 recorded captures and 1 emitted-waveform capture
notes: Each offer held out five contiguous 20 s blocks. The figure contrasts modeled 25 km rate changes with the measurement kernel and shows held likelihood against separated sites, a time shift and pooled orbit density. Position outcomes appear in the separate position charts.

title: Differential hint timing on complete stored IQ
